scope: Pre-merge validation of the Stats SA negative GDP prose guard
publisherStatement: Production GDP decreased by 0,2% in the second quarter of 2026.
observedFailure: The extracted value -0.2 was rejected because the publisher expressed the sign as 'decreased by' and printed only the unsigned magnitude.
repairBoundary: For negative values only, accept the exact magnitude when it immediately follows 'decreased by' and is presented as a percentage.
preserved: all existing sanity and provenance checks
negativeCases: increased by the same unsigned magnitude
the magnitude appears only in an unrelated contribution
a nearby value that would match only after decimal rounding
redRegression: The publisher sentence returned false for -0.2 before the repair; review then proved -0.24 incorrectly matched 0.2 when the prose exception rounded candidates.
